Quest name: Relics of the Great King
Quest location: Calicut Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Search, r17 Appraisal, DUT(Dutch)
Pre-requisite discovery: Charlemagne's crown discovery (from "Revival of the western Roman Empire" quest)
Pre-requisite action: Treasure Hunter's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
